_comment_ApiBaseUrl: REQUIRED: Program.cs throws if missing. Point at the deployed API host origin. Override via environment variable ApiBaseUrl in the hosting platform.

Retention._comment: The Web host must NOT run the Auth cleanup sweep — that runs on the API host only. This is a defensive default: the Web host does not currently register Auth infrastructure, but if it ever does, this keeps the background cleanup worker disabled here so cleanup never runs from two hosts.

ExternalAuth._comment: Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret with the API (same SigningKey on both sides). Supply via environment variables / key vault in production (ExternalAuth__SigningKey) — at least 32 bytes. Do NOT ship the dev key.

Recaptcha._comment: Only SiteKey is needed on the Web (client). Supply via environment variables (Recaptcha__SiteKey).

Google._comment: Authorized redirect URI MUST be https://<web-host>/signin-google. Supply ClientId/ClientSecret via environment variables / key vault (ExternalProviders__Google__ClientId, ExternalProviders__Google__ClientSecret).

Facebook._comment: Valid OAuth redirect URI MUST be https://<web-host>/signin-facebook. Supply AppId/AppSecret via environment variables / key vault (ExternalProviders__Facebook__AppId, ExternalProviders__Facebook__AppSecret).
